**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve spaces at soft breaks in mixed-break paragraphs**

When a paragraph contains both soft newlines and a hard break, `hard_break` selects `"".join(paragraph)` for the entire paragraph, concatenating words across every soft newline. For example, `one\ntwo  \nthree` becomes `onetwo\nthree` instead of `one two\nthree`. In longer, source-wrapped paragraphs this removes enough spaces to undercount rendered lines and recommend a height that clips the content. Preserve a space at each soft boundary while retaining newlines at hard boundaries.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Include bold text when measuring headings**

For profiles with `bold_width != 1` or a positive `bold_extra_line`, bold headings are underestimated because this branch strips the emphasis markers but leaves `_Block.bold` at zero. Paragraphs and list items populate that field, so the same formatting is measured differently inside a heading. For example, a long `# **...**` heading with `bold_width=2` can require five lines while this implementation counts three, producing a component height that clips the heading. Pass the heading's bold-character count into the block as well.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
